ragams.name: Bhoopalam
ragams.description: A serene pentatonic raga that evokes the calm of early dawn. Its simplicity and clarity make it ideal for sustained concentration.

ragams.name: Bilahari
ragams.description: A confident, expansive raga associated with courage and determination. Ideal for deep work sessions.

ragams.name: Neelambari
ragams.description: The quintessential lullaby raga, used for centuries to induce sleep. Its gentle, descending phrases calm the nervous system.

ragams.name: Khamaj
ragams.description: A tender, soothing raga associated with late evening. Its soft melodic movements ease the transition into rest.

ragams.name: Ananda Bhairavi
ragams.description: A raga of blissful devotion and gentle introspection. Its warm, lyrical phrases cultivate stillness and inner peace.

ragams.name: Sahana
ragams.description: A deeply emotive raga of longing and surrender. Its contemplative phrases draw the listener inward, ideal for breathwork and presence.
